judgment_text:
ORDER

Challenging the termination of his services by the third respondent, the petitioner is before this Court.

2. The facts are as follows:

2.1. The petitioner was appointed as Assistant Fitter by the third respondent on daily wages on a temporary basis on 1-7-1991 and the second respondent by proceedings, identified 86 such persons, who are eligible under G.O. Ms No. 55, Panchayat Department, dated 15-6-2006, called and requested them to produce their service record along with educational qualification for regularising the part-time/daily wage workers and bring them into the regular service.

2.2. The petitioner would submit that after perusing his qualifications, by proceedings dated 8-9-2007, the second respondent had appointed him as a Night Watchman in the Nagapattinam Panchayat Union.

2.3. Thereafter, the petitioner submitted his representation seeking transfer to his parent district and by proceedings dated 7-9-2017, he was transferred from Katpadi Panchayat Union and posted as Office Assistant. Thereafter, by proceedings of the second respondent dated 19-3-2018, he was transferred to the third respondent Panchayat Union where he was serving.

2.4. The petitioner would submit that he was due to retire on 30-11-2026 and at that point of time, the respondent sought to verify his certificates. It appears that the educational certificates were sent to the District Elementary Educational Officer, Ranipet, to verify the genuineness of the school certificates. By proceedings dated 18-12-2023, the District Elementary Educational Officer, Ranipet, reported that the educational certificates produced by the petitioner would indicate that he studied in the Panchayat Union Middle School was a bogus one. Thereafter, by proceedings dated 1-9-2025, the third respondent has passed the impugned order. Challenging the same, the petitioner is before this Court.

3. The respondents have filed the counter contending that the second respondent had forwarded the 8th Standard educational certificates of the petitioner to the District Elementary Educational Officer, Ranipet to verify its genuineness. By letter dated 3-11-2023, the third respondent had also sent a letter to the District Elementary Educational Officer, Ranipet, to examine the genuineness of the educational certificates of the petitioner.

4. By letter dated 18-12-2023, the District Elementary Educational Officer, Ranipet, had informed that the 8th Standard educational certificates produced by the petitioner is a bogus one and there were no records substantiating the same. On the basis of this information, the second respondent directed the third respondent to obtain an Explanation from the petitioner for taking appropriate action. Thereafter, the third respondent sent a notice to the petitioner on 9-6-2025 to submit his Explanation within a week from the date of receipt of the letter. The petitioner had submitted his Explanation stating that he had only studied upto 5th Standard in Ichiputhur Panchayat Union Middle School. Even this statement appears to be false. Therefore, the petitioner had been dismissed from service and no exception to be taken to the same.

5. Heard the learned counsels on either side.

6. Admittedly, the petitioner has submitted a bogus certificate. When the educational qualifications were called for, the petitioner has submitted a 8th standard educational certificates claiming to have studied in the Panchayat Union Middle School. This was found to be false and in the Explanation to the show-cause, he has responded that he had studied upto 5th Standard in Panchayat Union Middle School at Ichiputhur Village. Therefore, the petitioner who had earlier submitted an 8th Standard certificate has later stated that he had studied upto 5th Standard which once again is not supported by documents. The petitioner has in fact come forward with a false case. Such being the case, I see no reason to interfere with the order passed by the third respondent. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
